mechanism: Cenobamate may increase levetiracetam levels through potential CYP3A4 inhibition and competition for renal clearance, while additive CNS depression effects may occur with concurrent use of two antiepileptic agents.
action: Monitor for increased levetiracetam adverse effects (dizziness, somnolence, behavioral changes); consider levetiracetam dose reduction if toxicity emerges; therapeutic drug monitoring may be warranted.
